storyCards.headline: Rapstar: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Polo G's "Rapstar" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100. It was released through Columbia Records as the third single from his third studio album, Hall of Fame, on April 9, 2021.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 20 weeks on the chart.

Rapstar was released in 2021.
